memory_update.text: NOW, SNOW, PATH, DDOG, and ESTC should be tracked as software-layer candidates for the enterprise AI deployment-friction node, distinct from hyperscaler compute demand aggregators.
The investable chokepoint is shifting from raw model capability toward governed deployment: clean data, workflow orchestration, observability, security, cost control, and measurable ROI.

Need a later pass on cybersecurity-specific AI governance and identity control points, including ZS, CRWD, PANW, OKTA, and CYBR, because they may be adjacent chokepoints for agent authorization and data-loss prevention.
Need a later pass on CRM and application-suite incumbents such as CRM, ORCL, ADBE, INTU, and WDAY to separate true agentic workflow monetization from AI feature bundling.

node: Cloud AI platforms, enterprise automation software, data platforms, copilots, and agentic workflows
summary: Expanded universe for the enterprise AI deployment-friction node. The most relevant public-market mappings are not only hyperscaler compute aggregators, but software control points that sit between enterprise data, workflow systems, governance, observability, security, and ROI measurement. The strongest candidates for this pass are workflow automation platforms, data platforms, agent orchestration vendors, AI observability/security layers, and search/vector retrieval infrastructure. No buy/sell recommendation is implied.
